thread:
deploy-bot: Deploy v4.0.7 (sdk-v4) canary -> us-west-2 started by @Ethan :rocket:
Ethan: rolling out canary to 5% traffic now. watch for errors.
Lucy: seeing 502s on /v1/paging/streaming requests in canary logs, spike at 12:02 UTC. tagging oncall.
Jamal: @Lucy can you paste a sample log?
Lucy: here's a short tail from canary:```
2026-03-14T12:01:58Z paged-recv: frame=0x7f3f size=0x1a
2026-03-14T12:02:01Z decoder: unexpected_frame_type=0x0f, stream_id=4532
2026-03-14T12:02:01Z stream-err: code=E_FRAME_DECODE, msg=\"malformed paging frame\"
```
Maria: omg that's the new framing change from sdk v4 that switches header encoding. noticed a mismatch in our runtime decoder tests earlier but assumed compatibility shim would handle it.
Oncall Bot: @Jamal is now on-call for incidents (rotation: 2026-03-14 12:03 UTC).
Jamal: I'm on it. initial hypothesis: client bump introduced a header varint variant that the server runtime didn't accept for streaming pagination.
SRE: I'm seeing a 15% increase in 5xx for dedicated instances serving large seq-length paged queries. Metrics: p99 latency up 2x for paged endpoints.
Ethan: can we throttle canary to 0% while we triage? we still have some customers hitting canary.
deploy-bot: Canary traffic toggled to 0% for v4.0.7 by @Ethan
Customer Ops: two customers reported partial results and duplicate page tokens. ticket #INC-5512 opened.
Lucy: stack trace from worker:```
panic: invalid frame header
  at runtime/paging/decoder.go:142
  at runtime/serve/stream.go:281
```
Jamal: OK, rolling a kill-switch for the feature flag that enables the new framing. command: `ffctl disable sdk_v4_frame_encoding --env=prod`
Ethan: do it and confirm.
Jamal: executed: `ffctl disable sdk_v4_frame_encoding --env=prod --target=canary,dedicated`
Jamal: <reaction :thumbsup:> looks like errors dropped after ~30s. 5xx back to baseline.
SRE: confirmed p95/p99 returning to normal. no further panics in the logs.
Ethan: good. now we need a rollback plan for the release and customer impact note. @Customer Ops can you assemble impacted customers?
Customer Ops: pulling list from request logs with header variant marker. provisional list: AcmeAnalytics, MerchantX, Chatly Inc. raising P1 emails.
Lucy: replicable repro: run sdk v4 client with paged streaming and send a header where `frame_type=0x0f` and `header_len` uses LEB128. server chokes. older clients send header_len as fixed u16.
Maria: thinking: short-term hotfix options: 1) revert server decoder to accept both encodings, 2) force SDK to fallback, 3) rollback canary -> full rollback of v4.0.7. what's fastest?
Jamal: revert server decoder is quickest (single-line change) but we need test and patch release. rollback of sdk is longer because of CI and release signing.
Ethan: priority: restore user-facing stability. do server decoder revert + emergency patch. Jamal & Lucy work on patch, Maria help with tests. SRE, run extended validation sweep on dedicated nodes.
Jamal: creating patch branch `hotfix/paging-decoder-compat` now. pushing minimal decoder change to accept both varint and fixed len.
Lucy: adding unit tests for both encodings. will open PR shortly.
